system.description: Armor Class: 6 Hit Dice: 2* (M) Move: 90' (30') Attacks: 2 claws/1 bite Damage: 1d3/ld3/ld3 + special No. Appearing: 1d6 (2d8) Save As: F2 Morale: 9 Treasure Type: B Intelligence: 3 Alignment: Chaotic XP Value: 25 Monster Type: Monster (Common). This monster looks like a great quantity of clear jelly, usually in the form of a 10' x 10' x 10' cube. It is hard to see, and it surprises often (1-4 on 1d6).
